description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView used to display log data received via the LogNode interface in an Android application. It formats log messages with different severity levels and handles threading for UI updates.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs formatted log data received through the LogNode interface, supporting chaining with other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data with priority, tag, message, and throwable; updates UI thread safely; forwards to next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings with delimiters if they are not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
